# store_pore_dia { #mofography.percolation_results.store_pore_dia }

<span class="mg-tag mg-tag-recommended">go-to</span> Persists LCD/PLD/dfsd under method-specific keys on results dicts.

```python
percolation_results.store_pore_dia(
    results,
    method,
    lcd,
    pld,
    dfsd,
    *,
    lattice_variant=None,
    extra=None,
)
```

Store pore diameters under ``pore_dia_winding`` or ``pore_dia_lattice``.
